businesses.business: Life sciences sample management and genomics

offering_description.value: Azenta sells equipment and consumables for storing, tracking, and handling biological samples to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, universities, and research labs. It also stores and manages samples for customers and provides DNA sequencing and gene synthesis through its laboratory network.

primary_products.value: Automated sample storage systems; sample tubes and plates; sample handling and labeling instruments; sample inventory software

primary_services.value: Biological sample storage and management; sample transport and logistics; DNA sequencing and analysis; gene synthesis

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, universities, contract research organizations, and diagnostic laboratories; B2G: Government research agencies and public laboratories

end_markets.value: Pharmaceutical and biotechnology research; academic and government life sciences research; clinical research; molecular diagnostics

revenue_model.value: product sales: Sample storage systems, laboratory instruments, and consumables; service fees: Sequencing, gene synthesis, and sample handling; project or contract: Outsourced sample storage and management under customer agreements
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds sample storage and handling equipment and makes consumables for laboratories and biobanks; service provider: Stores and manages customer specimens and performs genomics work for research teams; asset operator: Runs biorepositories and genomics laboratories that receive samples from customers; software / platform: Provides software for laboratories and biobanks to track sample inventories
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; asset operator; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: Sample storage and handling systems, laboratory consumables, outsourced sample management, and genomics services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving biopharma companies, research institutions, and laboratories; online: Customer portals for ordering genomics services and buying laboratory supplies; distributors / dealers: Laboratory supply distributors for consumables and instruments

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Biospecimen storage and transport subject to biosafety, dangerous goods transport, and applicable data privacy rules

notes: The completion status of the B Medical Systems divestiture is uncertain.
